headline:
Strong growth,
well off its highs
chart_note: 52-week range: $65.08 - $126.71. Currently around $82.47, roughly 35% below the 52-week high even after a strong year of growth.
why_today: Little changed today, still trading well below its 52-week high even after a year of double-digit revenue and earnings growth.
pro_1: Revenue up roughly 15.9% and earnings up roughly 26.1% YoY - strong, accelerating growth
pro_2: PEG near 1.65 with an analyst consensus of Buy/Strong Buy and an average price target about 16% above the current price
con_1: Trading about 35% below its 52-week high ($126.71) - real weakness even with the strong fundamentals
con_2: PE near 25x still requires sustained growth to justify, and the competitive streaming landscape remains a real risk
